transcript: If you love AI, these five YouTube documentaries are a must-watch. Number one is The Thinking Game. This is one of my personal favorites. It shows how AI cracked a 50-year-old science problem that no scientist could solve, and how AlphaFold was built. Number two is The Age of A.I. It's an eight-part series hosted by Robert Downey Jr. that shows how AI is solving real problems in healthcare, robotics, and even space. Number three is In the Age of AI. The AI race is not just about tech companies anymore. This technology could decide which country becomes the next global superpower, and this documentary explores that rivalry between nations. Number four is AI Revolution. AI is already helping solve problems around the world, but what if the same technology creates problems we can't control? This one gives you a balanced look at both the promise and the risks of AI. And number five is What's the Future of Gen AI? Everyone knows what gen AI can do today. This documentary shows you a future that very few people are talking about. Send this to a friend who loves AI, and follow us for more recommendations like this.
